descriptions: MAJOR RELEASE — the biggest update bablo-hud has ever had. Almost every part of the HUD has been redrawn from the ground up.

IMPORTANT: This is a full resource replacement. Please remove and replace the entire resource — do not merge with your existing 1.x install. The latest v1.x release remains available on the Cfx.re Portal under the Versions tab for rollback if needed.

Missing something from v1.x? We know this is a huge update and we may have missed features you relied on. If anything you loved from v1.x isn't in v2.0, please open a suggestion in our suggestions channel and we'll look at bringing it back!
New frosted-glass visual style across every element, with blur that adapts to bright and dark scenes.
Added 4 new car speedometer designs: Round Modern (new default), Round Arc, Digital Bar, and Racing Angle — alongside the classic Round. Every speedometer is fully recolourable per-design.

Added dedicated bicycle HUD (speed bar + optional heart-rate pill), boat HUD (rotating compass disc, direction cone, fuel arc), and aircraft HUD (compass disc, airspeed/fuel arcs, pitch badge) shared by planes and helicopters.

Added Vehicle Info Bar — a separate movable element with blinkers, engine state/health, doors, locks, seatbelt, headlights (off/low/high), and odometer. Aircraft get landing gear, rotor health, STALL warning, altitude, vertical speed; boats get anchor state and water depth.

Added persistent mileage tracking per licence plate, stored in the database (auto-created bablo_hud_mileage table). GetOdometer/SetOdometer exports available. Set Config.Mileage.provider = 'framework' to defer to external scripts like jg-vehiclemileage.

Added Vehicle Control Panel (M or /carcontrol) — control engine, headlights, interior light, locks, individual doors/windows, blinkers/hazards, and seat switching. Configurable via Config.VehicleControl with exports for other scripts.
Added blinker keybinds (Left/Right/Down arrows by default, rebindable in FiveM key bindings).
Added rev-limiter effects, gear-change pop animations, faded leading zeros, and low-fuel warnings on every speedometer design.
Redesigned compass — scrolling heading tape with 5° ticks, degree labels, cardinal letters, accent centre marker, and a street/zone pill beneath. Follows the camera smoothly every frame.

Added Config.MinimapTransition — a branded panel slides over the minimap when the radar shows or hides. Choose slide or shutter style, colour/gradient, custom logo, and timing. /hudcurtain freezes it for lining up.
Added Config.HideNativeTexts to hide GTA's native street/area/vehicle popups.
Minimap now auto re-anchors on resolution/aspect ratio/safe zone changes — no relog needed.
Resizable minimap in the editor (size, maxSize, and widthScale for true-square rendering).
6 redrawn status bar designs: Classic, Minimal, Compact (new default), Stacked, Hexagon, Bars — with a brand-new hand-drawn icon set.
Drag-and-drop status layout in the editor — reorder icons, drag out into own groups, merge back with one click.
Microphone can live in the status bar (default) or as a standalone element (Config.DefaultSettings.voice.location) with its own colour.
Status colours now accept HEX (#FF4D4D) as well as HSL, with per-status Reset to Default buttons.
Redesigned player-info stack — right-aligned pills (logo, ID, time, cash, bank, job + grade) with per-pill colours, corner radius, and merged/separated layout.
Time pill can show in-game clock, PC clock, or server clock (playerInfo.timeSource).

Added dirty money and gang pills — read through framework bridge (ESX black_money and QBCore/Qbox gangs out of the box). Any script can be connected in a few lines. Toggle server-wide with showDirtyMoney/showGang.
Added Config.Currency for money formatting ($_, _ kr, €_, _ $).
Added RefreshPlayerInfo export / bablo-hud:playerinfo:refresh event for instant refresh after external changes.
Notifications now auto-reposition when the player-info stack grows/shrinks so they never overlap.
Added standalone ammo counter as a movable element (auto-slides away from notifications).
Server logo now sits at the top of the player-info stack (Config.ServerLogo).
Redesigned notifications (type-coloured cards with countdown ring), segmented progress bar with percentage, and control hints with customisable key colour.
Added manual progress bars — start with manual = true and drive with UpdateProgressBar(value, label) / CompleteProgressBar() for open-ended actions.
Added runtime control hints — ShowControlHints({...}, duration), HideControlHints, ClearControlHints (and events) for scripts to push key prompts.
Redesigned settings menu with icon sidebar and live previews. Now openable with a keybind (I by default) as well as the command (now /hudsettings).
Placement editor overhauled — Save & Finish / Cancel & Exit (Esc cancels), right-click menu on every element (hide, reset, rotate, 3D tilt), grid & snap, magnetic centring with guide lines.
Hand-placed elements are now pinned — automatic overlap avoidance routes around them instead of shoving.
Global Config's Publish Globally now merges into the existing config instead of overwriting, and includes minimap size/position.
Rebuilt resolution scaling — layouts made at 2K land in the same spot at 1080p and 4K. Right/bottom-anchored elements remember their edge distance.
Frosted glass applied across compass, dark pills, vehicle info bar, waypoint pill, and several speedometers — blur tone-adjusted for bright scenes.
Speedometer needles and arcs animate smoothly frame by frame; RPM reads zero at idle instead of creeping.
Buckling up now disables GTA's own windshield ejection.
Editor drag threshold lowered from 10 px to 3 px. Reset Position also resets size and tilt.
Colour pickers accept hex codes and presets everywhere.
Fixed ResizeObserver loop limit errors in the F8 console.
Config file is now much shorter — long explanations replaced by one-line hints.
Changed defaults: Round Modern speedometer, Compact status, playerInfo scale 1.0, /hudsettings command, mic in status bar.
Compass is now a free element (top-centre) instead of sitting above the minimap.
Time pill shows 12-hour AM/PM; progress bar shows percentage; ammo turns red only when magazine is empty.
Notifications, progress bar, and control hints each have one design now — players customise colours instead of picking styles.
Removed speedometer designs: Basic, Frosted, Flat, Sport Basic, Sport, and the old helicopter cockpit layout.
Removed status designs: Aura, Wave, Wave Flat, Radar, Pro, Flow, Eclipse, Badge, Capsule, Premium, Solid Hex, Outline Hex, Legacy Hex (players fall back to Classic).
Removed the old compass card/pill/bar looks and their style/opacity/per-pill toggles.
Removed player-editable notification style/theme/opacity/sound, progress bar style/radius/colours, player-info opacity, speedometer highlight switch, and control-hint design switch.
Removed the free-floating server logo, weapon image/name card, Config.ControlHints.variant, and Config.ServerLogo.scale.
oxmysql is now required (used by persistent mileage). Set Config.Mileage.persistent = false to disable database usage.
Player settings and layouts start fresh — saved settings and minimap positions moved to new storage keys, so everyone starts from your server defaults. Editor element positions carry over.
config.lua must be redone from the new file — sections reorganised and many new options added.
Resource is now simply 'bablo-hud' (events and exports use the bablo-hud: prefix). Update any references to 'bablo-hud-v2' from the beta.
